title: Define serve.Deps interface and SSE event types as API contract
description: Pin the data model and API shape: define the complete serve.Deps struct, all HTTP route signatures, SSE event types and their JSON payloads (token, assistant, tool_call, tool_result, usage, approval-needed, model-switched, error, done, task-status, task-attempt, wave-changed, run-report), session.Info, modelcat.Entry, skills.Skill, phaseflow.Task types. This is the contract that gophermind-server and gophermind-osx both build against.
acceptance_criteria: serve.Deps struct is fully defined with all function signatures
All SSE event types are defined as Go structs with JSON tags
All HTTP route paths and methods are documented in a contract file or doc comment
session.Info, modelcat.Entry, skills.Skill, phaseflow.Task types are defined
The contract compiles and is importable by both server and client
